description: Boot the application and enter the first run state.
Move and complete a grounded jump without invalid state.
Dash and resolve a one-way platform contact.
Generate a blade contact above the valid cut threshold.
Deflect a standard projectile without invalid player health.
Clear a wave and enter the draft state.
Select one legal draft choice and resume gameplay.
At one HP, trigger the real Source void-fall rescue through semantic movement, seal it, and verify fresh pre/post-rescue Ghost V3 production seeks.

evidence.artifact: An ephemeral sealed and verified Ghost V3 capsule, including 60-tick canonical keyframes, a one-HP semantic void-fall rescue, its native world.void-rescue fact, and three fresh production-world seek receipts both before and after rescue.
evidence.artifactRetention: The browser proof verifies the capsule and receipts in its isolated test profile; it does not retain a checked-in release artifact.
